purpose: Improve the source operation at matched16-member budget using source-only downstream integrated gradients; preserve geometric16/full-source/atom controls and compare actual cross-SAE target execution on the same exploratory external components
budget: At most 2700 seconds CPU-heavy managed wall, four compute threads, estimated less than 10GB RAM and 1GB E-drive artifacts; no GPU use, new network access or paid resource. Initial measured throughput determines continuation. Existing GPU training proceeds independently.
scope: All rows come from released train and remain exploratory. Prompt-connected components prevent exact-input and reciprocal leakage. Tasks/sites are selected for structural diversity before outputs; no source- or target-effect filtering. One SAE seed direction is a pilot, not the required five-seed main suite. Native interventions preserve the reconstruction residual and require nonnegative final code, but do not assert TopK encoder realizability. Group-L1, ridge, assignment and bounded sparse coding are standard components, not solver-novelty claims. CausalGym test is not read. This does not reproduce the full CausalGym method benchmark or SemanticOT. Source selection now uses discovery task labels and downstream gradients, explicitly supervised; target matching does not inspect evaluation labels. Same source budget16 geometric/IG comparison is retained.
